stage: A -- protocol lock, written before submission
purpose: Benchmark 3 of docs/experiments/FOUR_LOCALIZATION_BENCHMARKS_CLUSTER_HANDOFF.md: correctness of EVERY reasoning step. ProcessBench annotates only the FIRST wrong step and certifies nothing after it, so it structurally cannot measure an every-step classifier. PRMBench supplies the missing per-step ground truth. Two jobs over the IDENTICAL official traces so row ids align exactly.

benchmark.paper: PRMBench: A Fine-grained and Challenging Benchmark for Process-Level Reward Models (Song et al., arXiv:2501.03124, ACL 2025)

measured_corpus_stats.note_on_paper_numbers: 6,216 problems / 83,456 step labels reproduce EXACTLY from the Hub download, asserted in spectral_utils.prmbench.smoke(check_corpus=True).

four_official_details_that_are_not_guess: The evaluated question is `modified_question`, NOT the dataset's own `question` field. `question` differs from BOTH `original_question` and `modified_question` on roughly 250-500 rows per class, so using it would silently mis-condition thousands of traces.

A synthetic `correct` class is CONSTRUCTED by the loader, not shipped: every `redundency` row seeds an extra sample from `original_question` + `original_process` with error_steps=[]. The all-steps-correct control class exists only because load_data_function creates it, and it is scored but NOT pooled into the totals.

`labels[i] == 1` means the scorer asserts step i is VALID. POSITIVE_LABEL = 1 and TP counts NON-ERROR steps the model accepted -- the positive class of the official F1 is correct steps, not errors. A risk score must be inverted before entering this metric.

100 rows annotate an error step index past the end of their own trace. The official loop only tests `idx in hallucination_steps` for idx in range(len(labels)), so those indices are inert. Rows are KEPT and the count is reported -- never silently dropped, never silently repaired.

prmbench_qwen25math7b_full.protocol: spectral_utils/prm_scorer.py reused verbatim from the ProcessBench PRM job (AutoModel classification head, official chat template, <extra_0> separators, make_step_rewards reduction order, and the _patch_cache_compat() DynamicCache shim that fixed job 176541). label = 1 if reward >= 0.5 else 0.
prmbench_qwen25math7b_full.threshold_rationale: ProcessBench's own published PRM decision boundary, reused UNCHANGED. Tuning it on PRMBench labels would convert a published ceiling into a fitted method.
prmbench_qwen25math7b_full.supervision_access_sampling: human-process-label-trained PRM (PRM800K-style). Supervised ceiling, never reported as a peer of a label-free score.
prmbench_qwen25math7b_full.cost_profile: one forward pass per problem, no generation -- a couple of GPU-hours.

prmbench_qwen3_8b_telemetry_full.protocol: fork of cluster/run_teacher_forced.py in which ONLY build_items changes. forward_batch / candidate_quantities / batched / Gate B / the SIGTERM+exit-85 contract are imported unchanged, so there is one definition of each per-token quantity in the repo. Conditioning prompt = math_prompt + ' /no_think', identical to the ProcessBench cells the local head was frozen on.
prmbench_qwen3_8b_telemetry_full.cost_profile: one teacher-forced forward pass per problem -- same class as the ProcessBench telemetry job.

declared_adaptation: For classes `redundency` and `circular`, the official evaluator PREFERS a model's step_level_redundancy_labels head and only falls back to step_level_validity_labels when that head is absent. Neither our score nor a plain PRM reward has a redundancy head, so both arms take the fallback path. prmbench_evaluate() records this as used_redundancy_head=false with an explicit adaptation_note. Those two subcategories are therefore NOT exact reproductions and must be labelled accordingly.

our_step_score_freezing.primary_aggregation: maximum token risk inside each official step -- the same convention as the frozen first-error locator in docs/methods/gl_liu_v1.md
our_step_score_freezing.sensitivity_aggregation: 95th-percentile token risk, plus correlation between step risk and step length
our_step_score_freezing.rule: BOTH are frozen before any evaluation label is read. Selecting between aggregations on test labels is forbidden.

no_pilot: Per Omri's 2026-08-10 instruction this campaign skips N=30 GPU pilots and submits at full size. Offline risk was retired instead of on GPU: spectral_utils/prmbench.py::smoke(check_corpus=True) passes 9 known-answer checks including an exact reproduction of the published 6,216 / 83,456 corpus statistics, the 5-row dedup gap, the 160 empty and 100 out-of-range annotation counts, and the label-polarity convention in both directions.
still_out_of_scope: prmtest_classified_subset400; the BoN evaluation path (mr_eval/bon_eval); ReasonEval and the other leaderboard PRMs.
